title: Foo Fighters: The Band
description: From one man's demo tapes after Nirvana to stadium rock royalty: Dave Grohl's band, its members and its records.

cards.prompt: Who founded Foo Fighters and fronts the band?
cards.details: Often called "the nicest guy in rock", and one of its hardest-working musicians.

cards.prompt: Dave Grohl was the drummer in which band before Foo Fighters?
cards.details: After Kurt Cobain's death in 1994, Grohl stepped out from behind the kit to sing and play guitar.

cards.prompt: What did "foo fighters" mean in WWII pilot slang?
cards.details: Allied pilots used it for unexplained glowing objects. Grohl has said he regrets the name a little, but it stuck!

cards.prompt: In what year did Foo Fighters release their self-titled debut album?
cards.details: It started as essentially a one-man project: Grohl played almost every instrument himself.

cards.prompt: What is the name of Dave Grohl's record label, which releases Foo Fighters albums?
cards.details: Named after Roswell, New Mexico, site of the famous 1947 "UFO crash". The UFO theme runs deep.

cards.prompt: What is Foo Fighters' 1997 second album?
cards.details: The first made as a full band. Many fans still call it their best.

cards.prompt: Complete the title of the beloved 1997 Foo Fighters love song: "Ever___"
cards.details: It became the song the band so often closes shows with, and a staple of acoustic covers.

cards.prompt: Which Colour and the Shape single is a tribute to ordinary, everyday heroes?
cards.details: Its pounding drums and big chorus made it a rock radio staple.

cards.prompt: Who was Foo Fighters' first drummer?
cards.details: He left during the making of The Colour and the Shape, and Grohl re-recorded many of the drum parts himself.

cards.prompt: Which drummer joined Foo Fighters in 1997 and became Grohl's closest bandmate?
cards.details: A high-energy, fan-favourite drummer who also sang lead on some songs live.

cards.prompt: In what year did Taylor Hawkins die?
cards.details: He died on tour in Bogotá, Colombia. The band later held two huge tribute concerts in his honour.

cards.prompt: Which Foo Fighters guitarist played in the LA punk band The Germs and toured with Nirvana?
cards.details: Known for his huge grin on stage. He has been in and out of the band but is a longtime member.

cards.prompt: Which Foo Fighters bassist came from the Seattle emo band Sunny Day Real Estate?
cards.details: One of the band's longest-serving members, from the first full line-up.

cards.prompt: Which guitarist joined Foo Fighters in 1999 and has stayed ever since?
cards.details: He came from the punk band No Use for a Name.

cards.prompt: Which 1999 album won Foo Fighters their first Grammy for Best Rock Album?
cards.answer: There Is Nothing Left to Lose
cards.details: Recorded in Grohl's home studio in Virginia, and more relaxed than its predecessor.

cards.prompt: Which 2002 album featured the single "All My Life"?
cards.details: "All My Life" goes from a whisper to a scream, a Foo Fighters trademark.

cards.prompt: Which One by One single urges you to make the most of life, "It's times like these…"?
cards.details: Grohl later re-recorded it acoustic, and it became an anthem of resilience.

cards.prompt: Which 2005 double album has one rock disc and one acoustic disc?
cards.details: A deliberate split showing both sides of the band, loud and quiet.

cards.prompt: Which In Your Honor single is a defiant anthem: "Best ___ ___"?
cards.details: Prince famously covered it in the pouring rain during his 2007 Super Bowl halftime show.

cards.prompt: Which 2007 single opens Echoes, Silence, Patience & Grace?
cards.details: A slow-building, furious rocker that became one of their biggest hits.

cards.prompt: Which 2011 album was recorded on analog tape in Dave Grohl's garage?
cards.details: Produced by Butch Vig, who also produced Nirvana's Nevermind. No computers, just tape.

cards.prompt: Which producer, famous for Nirvana's Nevermind, produced Wasting Light?
cards.details: A reunion that closed a loop for Grohl, twenty years after Nevermind.

cards.prompt: Which 2014 album was recorded in eight different US cities alongside an HBO series?
cards.details: Each song was written and recorded in a different music city, with lyrics inspired by local interviews.

cards.prompt: In which Swedish city did Dave Grohl fall off the stage and break his leg in 2015?
cards.details: He finished the show with his leg in a cast, then toured seated on a giant guitar-necked throne.

cards.prompt: What was Foo Fighters' 2017 album, produced by pop producer Greg Kurstin?
cards.details: Big, layered rock with a pop producer's polish.

cards.prompt: Which 2021 Foo Fighters album has a dancey, disco-tinged feel?
cards.details: Grohl described it as their "party record".

cards.prompt: What was the band's 2023 album, their first after Taylor Hawkins' death?
cards.details: A raw record about grief that many fans see as one of their most emotional.

cards.prompt: In what year were Foo Fighters inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame?
cards.details: Their first year of eligibility. Grohl was already in the Hall with Nirvana.

cards.prompt: What is the title of Dave Grohl's 2013 documentary about a legendary LA recording studio?
cards.details: It's about the studio where Nevermind was recorded. Grohl bought its famous mixing console.
